verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers PyAirbyte (official Python SDK for AI/data developers), a REST API, and a Terraform provider, plus an official MCP server for agent connectivity — solid official SDK/tooling coverage for AI-native builders. However, evidence is thin on SDKs beyond Python (no official JS/TS or other language SDKs mentioned), no independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and community feedback focuses on deployment friction rather than SDK experience. Missing for 10: multi-language SDK coverage, independent/hands-on validation of PyAirbyte's developer experience, and clearer API reference/OpenAPI spec (probe found no discoverable openapi.json).
